tools.name: combine_map_links
tools.description: Merge several Google Maps directions links into one link with all stops in order, to get past the 10-stop limit per route. Short links are expanded. When one route ends where the next starts, the shared stop is kept once.

tools.name: list_link_stops
tools.description: The stops of one Google Maps directions link, in order, as MapCombiner reads them. Use it to check links before combining. For coordinates, distances or CSV/KML export, use MapParser (parseUrl).
